content.short: Curve Subgraph provides a GraphQL API to query Curve protocol on-chain data via the Graph Protocol.
content.description: Curve Subgraph lets developers query and index data from Curve protocol smart contracts. It leverages a GraphQL API to expose on-chain information such as liquidity pool balances, transaction history, and data related to swaps and liquidity. The extracted data can be used to power apps, analyze user behavior, and build new features that interact with the Curve protocol. By providing a stable, queryable view of Curve data, it helps teams develop applications, analyze user behavior, and design additional capabilities that connect with Curve.

resources.tldr: A subgraph precompiles and caches raw chain data, which is what makes an aggregate query return in one request.
